item.title: Men's Basketball Rounds Out Regular Season with Win at EKU
Women's Tennis Storms Past Samford on the Road
item.description: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – The Lipscomb University Women's Tennis team wrapped up the weekend with a 5-2 victory over Samford University on Sunday morning from the Samford Tennis Center.

item.title: Baseball Holds Off Toledo; Goes for Series Split on Monday
item.description: NASHVILLE – The Lipscomb University Baseball team used a five-run fourth and held of a late effort by the University of Toledo to take down the Rockets, 9-7, Sunday afternoon in the third game of a four-game wrap-around series from Ken Dugan Field at Stephen Lee Marsh Stadium.

item.title: Heard, Bowen Represented on ASUN Postseason Awards
item.description: JACKSONVILLE, Fla. – The Atlantic Sun Conference announced on Monday morning its postseason awards. Voted on by the league's head coaches, Molly Heard was picked to the third team on the All-ASUN Team.

item.title: Baseball Powers Past Rockets to Earn Series Split
item.description: NASHVILLE – The Lipscomb University Baseball team prevailed from a slow start in the series by earning a split with the University of Toledo with a 13-5 victory on Monday afternoon from Ken Dugan Field at Stephen Lee Marsh Stadium.

item.title: Asman, Esmeraldo Named Postseason All-ASUN, Four Bisons Earn Academic All-ASUN Honors
item.description: NASHVILLE – Lipscomb's Grant Asman and Mateo Esmeraldo garnered postseason All-ASUN honors, the league announced Tuesday. Asman was named First Team All-ASUN while Esmeraldo earned a spot on the Third Team. In addition, Asman was named Academic All-ASUN along with Charlie Williams, Ross Candelino, and Kellan Boylan. Lipscomb went 12-6 in the ASUN and 19-12 overall to earn the No. 4 seed in the ASUN Tournament.

item.title: Dolzhenko Tapped ASUN Women's Tennis Player of the Week
item.description: JACKSONVILLE – Announced by the Atlantic Sun Conference on Tuesday, Mariia Dolzhenko of the Lipscomb University Women's Tennis team was announced as the league's Player of the Week.

item.title: Women's Basketball's Late Effort in Second Half Falls Short to Austin Peay in ASUN First Round
item.description: JACKSONVILLE, Fla. – The Lipscomb University Women's Basketball team outscored Austin Peay State University 40-35 in the second half, but it was the Governors that eliminated the Bisons in the opening round of the 2026 Atlantic Sun Conference Women's Basketball Tournament by a final score of 63-56, Tuesday afternoon from UNF Arena on the campus of the University of North Florida.

item.title: Continued Impact Far Beyond The Game
item.description: In college athletics, change is inevitable. Players graduate. Coaches move on. Systems evolve. But every program has a few constants—people whose presence quietly anchor everything else. For Lipscomb Men's Basketball, one of those constants is Conner Mirt.

item.title: Men's Golf Finishes Sixth at Sam Ryder Intercollegiate
item.description: VIERA, Fla. – Lipscomb Men's Golf wrapped up play at the Sam Ryder Intercollegiate on Tuesday with a sixth-place team finish after three competitive rounds.
